messages:
Emma: Quick heads-up — PR #9345 needs 2x LGTM before the 21:00 UTC cutoff (t-minus ~35m). Blocking the hotfix cutover. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/9345. Small kv-warmup tweak + config guard, low LOC but sensitive.
Raj: Taking an initial pass now, will flag anything obvious in ~10m.
Oliver: I can be second-eye after my call at 20:45 UTC. If you need earlier backup, ping Morgan.
Emma: Thanks. CI kicked off smoke; if both approve we merge and run a short perf smoke post-merge. If not 2x by cutoff, plan is autobackout for the cutover.
CI-bot: Smoke tests queued (build 5678) — estimated 6m. Status will post here.
Raj: Quick note — I found one missing nil-check in handler, pushing a one-line fix to the branch in a sec.
Oliver: Re: risk — main thing is kv cache contention under high rps. Suggest a tiny perf run: ./scripts/perf-smoke.sh --concurrency 100 --pr 9345
Raj: Running perf now. Output (summary): p50 12ms, p95 +3ms vs main, no alloc spikes. Looks ok to me.
Sasha: If we get two approvals I'll also update the CHANGELOG.md and bump the patch. I can do that right after merge.
Emma: @Oliver if you can't make the 20:45 window, please @Morgan as backup. We need someone to stamp before cutoff.
Oliver: I should be able to make it. If comms fail: @Morgan please be ready.
Morgan: On it, just saw this. Can review in ~8m and give a thumbs if clean.
Raj: LGTM from me — fixed the nil-check and added a unit.
Oliver: Reviewed, ran the perf snippet locally, :+1: from me. Small nit about log message wording (non-blocking).
Emma: Great — two-eyes achieved at 20:52 UTC. Proceeding to merge and run the post-merge smoke. Thanks all. :rocket:
Deploy-bot: Cutover ticket updated: PR #9345 merged, post-merge smoke in progress. If smoke fails, auto-backout will trigger.
CI-bot: Post-merge smoke passed (build 5680). No regressions flagged.
Emma: Closing the loop — merged and safe. Will monitor for 15m then proceed with cutover. Thanks team! :tada:
